source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Cissus incisa Des Moul. (historic species concept; modern synonym crosswalk pending)

historical_cissus_incisa_comparator.habit: Deciduous or semi-evergreen vine with white pith and tendrils opposite leaves
historical_cissus_incisa_comparator.leaves: Simple to usually 3-foliolate, fleshy sharply toothed blunt leaflets; leaves to ~8 cm
historical_cissus_incisa_comparator.flowers: Four-merous greenish blooms, four stamens, four-lobed floral disk

source_scope_note: Historical variety and comparator limits explicit; no morphology automatically assigned beyond source taxon concept.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: 1999 source treats Cissus incisa, NOT Cissus trifoliata directly; project taxonomic notes link names but historic source limits must be retained

Flora separately cites Cissus trifoliata (L.) L. as a related Arizona/Mexico species in toxicology note; this may represent a DIFFERENT historic concept and requires formal synonym validation before transferring incisa morphology
preservation: Additive only; species records, pictures, credits and gallery unchanged
